content:
**Pepper** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A shaker of pepper seasoning. It is used to make things taste better.

- Six in Helvetia.
 - Four at the Freyja's Haus restaurant.
 - One at the butcher's house, the building with a billiard table.
 - One at the Honey Haus, on the window.
- Four at The Whitespring Golf Club.
- Four in Knife Edge.
- Four in Bolton Greens.
- Three in Red Rocket Mega Stop.
- Three in The General's Steakhouse.
- Two can be found at White Powder Winter Sports.
- Two at Hemlock Holes.
- Two at Firebase Major.
- Two in Bastion Park.
- Two at the restaurant in Flatwoods.
- One at Portside Pub.
- One can be found at Big Fred's BBQ Shack.
- One at Skullbone Vantage.
- One at Mountainside Bed & Breakfast.
- One at Hillfolk Hotdogs.
- One at Autumn Acre Cabin.
- One at Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.
- One at Cobbleton Farm.
- One at Clancy Manor.
- One near Welch in the building with Overseer's Journal, Entry 5.
